insight: Acquired by AI ad-tech firm Appier in 2025 for $38.7M, its fifth acquisition since 2018.
name: AdCreative.ai
tagline: Generates conversion-focused ad creatives, video, and product shots with AI scoring.
description: AdCreative.ai generates ad banners, copy, product photography, and video ads for platforms like Google and Meta without design skills. Its Creative Scoring AI predicts which creatives will perform, and it pulls competitor and audience insights to inform generation.
edge: Couples ad-creative generation with a Creative Scoring model that predicts performance before you spend.
pros: Generates banners, copy, product shots, video
Competitor and audience insights built in
